title: Day 6: Reviews That Weren't Reviews, and a Killed Agent That Stayed Dead
summary: The lead agent retracted four reviews and test runs that came from its own scripts. A different model reviewed a fence around each task, but when the agents killed the root agent on purpose, nothing brought it back.
author: Alexey Grigorev
